title: stubtest crashes with `TypeError` when runtime value is a proxy object that    overrides `__class__`

title: Unreachable false positive in match statement with tuples

ai_result.root_cause: In `mypy/checkpattern.py`, the `visit_sequence_pattern` method incorrectly computes the `rest_type` for sequence patterns with empty list subpatterns (`[]`). When matching `_, []` against `tuple[list, list]`, the empty list pattern narrows the second element to `Never` (since an empty list is the only possible match for `[]`), and then the `rest_type` calculation erroneously propagates that `Never` to the first element of the tuple as well. This causes the subject type for subsequent cases to become `tuple[Never, list]`, making the pattern `[], _` appear impossible and triggering a false positive unreachable warning.
ai_result.fix_suggestion: In `mypy/checkpattern.py`, `visit_sequence_pattern` method, fix the `rest_type` calculation when handling empty sequence subpatterns. When computing the rest type after a failed match of a sequence pattern against a tuple type, ensure that elements that were not constrained by the pattern (like the first element in `_, []`) retain their original type rather than being narrowed to `Never` due to an empty list match on another element.
